fixed_by_run.why: The standfirst says 'Ministers call the request a stunt', and the Hindi says 'मंत्रियों ने इसे सियासी स्टंट बताया'. No minister said that in the sources. 'Nothing but political stunt' came from chief prosecutor Md Aminul Islam (The Star); State Minister Humaiun Kobir called it 'utterly ridiculous' (Daily Star).
